environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 with default namespace. Container runs as privileged with hostPath volume mount to /dev/mem and /proc/self/mem. Pod spec includes securityContext.privileged=true, hostPID=true. The container image is based on ubuntu:22.04 with full toolchain. No memory safety mitigations (compiled with -fno-stack-protector -z execstack). The node runs kernel 5.15 without KASLR. Container has CAP_SYS_PTRACE allowing /proc/*/mem writes for heap grooming after UAF trigger.
